limitations.notes: Left knee drifts in under heavy squats (no injury). Fix: banded lateral walks before the bar (+5 toward the left), Bulgarian split squats left leg first, abductor, hip thrust; cue "spread the floor".
Hips rise first out of the hole (slow middle third). Fix: pause squats, hack squat for quad strength, cue "chest up, knees forward"; setup under 10 s.
Habit: overshooting — turning working sets into max attempts, adding reps beyond the plan. Barbell lifts capped at RPE 8 (RIR 2); the top set is the set; no max singles outside test weeks.

coach_notes: Goal #1 is to look good (muscle, arms, abs, shoulders); the 1-2-3-4 plate strength targets (OHP 60, bench 100, squat 140, deadlift 180 kg) are the vehicle.

Field service technician: physical shifts up to 12 h. Work days count as training load: in heavy work weeks train 4 days and drop the arms day first; tired after a hard work day → rest, don't force it.
Top set = one triple at RPE 8 (2 reps left); increase only when it feels like RPE 7. Back-offs: 3 sets, 5 → 6 → 7 reps, then +5 kg and back to 5s. Accessories: double progression.

Barbell lifts never above RPE 8; no max singles outside test weeks; failure only on the last set of isolation / machine work. Known habit to watch: overshooting (maxing instead of working sets, extra reps).

6-week cycle, then a test week on the lift closest to its target. When a target falls, lock it (hit twice, clean), then shift effort to the lift furthest away. No heavy deadlifts within 4 days of a squat test.
Logs 3 numbers per session: top set, last back-off set, one accessory pushed that cycle; everything else on feel.
Tight grip / elbows after arm work → forearm flexor and extensor stretches.
Recovery: protein 1.6–2 g/kg/day; sleep is the biggest lever; long work days are the main threat. Pre-workout coffee 30–45 min before (max 2 cups), carbs 60–90 min before; protein within 1–2 h after.
